authorization: User requested delegated execution in other chats at lower effort or weaker models, managed until a useful algorithm checkpoint.
efficiency_policy: Three scoped low-effort worker chats; no worker subdelegation; concise summaries and bounded experiments. No token/cost savings measured or guaranteed.

threads.initial_scope: profile current baseline and implement A only
proofs, counterexamples and English method draft
independent controls, freeze protocol, prepare harness; official timing held for manager source review

public_entrypoint_change: only after proof, independent correctness, reviewed fresh benchmarks and regression guardrails

pre_registered_decision.target_benefit: A: >=20% median end-to-end reduction on at least one target, or all candidate repetitions complete while baseline repetitions are incomplete; candidate count reduction independently checked
pre_registered_decision.guardrails: Known-K A_K4 and D_K4 median regression >15% blocks automatic promotion pending explanation and review; no selective reruns
pre_registered_decision.negative_evidence: preserve all regressions, failures, timeouts, screening attempts and budget-unstarted work
